rundown: Aleksandr Shevchenko beat Adrian Mannarino in sets: 6-1, 6-3.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 10, 6:57 AM ET. It had Adrian Mannarino 59% and Aleksandr Shevchenko 41%.

Final: Adrian Mannarino 0 – Aleksandr Shevchenko 2. Wrong winner: it had Adrian Mannarino at 59%, and Aleksandr Shevchenko (41%) won.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: Adrian Mannarino to win: the algo gave it 59%, THE PICK — lost.

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body: Flagged going in: there were no odds to check the projection against.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body: The result goes into both players' Elo ratings at the next data run, so their next match is priced on it.
